# docs_audit_report — 2026-06-18

## TOP 3 PROBLEMS
1. License contradiction — hero badge + meta say "MIT-0," footer says "Apache 2.0 License." A stranger evaluating adoption cannot tell the actual license. Most damaging trust failure on the page.
2. "FoVer" number salad + insider jargon — 0.9131, architecture-only 0.8947, retracted 0.9857, AND a "0.125 FoVer baseline" all collide with no plain-English definition of what FoVer even is. Reader can't tell which number is real.
3. Results = 12 jargon-tagged cards with suspiciously perfect scores (TP 1.0, 60/60, 0.90 vs 0.125). A stranger skims none, and the perfect numbers read as cherry-picked rather than credible.

## DETAILED FINDINGS

### Bloat

- Features section — 7 cards under "Seven capabilities" — 3 aren't capabilities (see Inconsistencies); trim to actual checkable capabilities.
